headline: Bond Yields Sink Below 5% as AI Stock Risks Drive Treasury Inflow
summary: Bond yields sank below 5% as investors flooded back into Treasurys for safety. Market participants are hedging against the risks of potential AI fallout across stock and credit markets.
why: U.S. Treasurys represent the global benchmark for risk-free assets, with safe-haven flows rapidly shifting yields during periods of market stress.

impacts.name: U.S. 10-Year Treasury
impacts.why: Heavy safe-haven buying of government bonds drives debt prices higher and pushes yields downward.

why_moved: Investors rotated capital aggressively out of risk assets and into government bonds to hedge potential fallout from artificial intelligence valuations.
